snippet.title: Iterum - Official Trailer (2024)
snippet.description:
Welcome, Consul! 

In Iterum, you will build and manage your settlements, balancing food production, taxation, and citizen happiness. 
Recruit and sustain armies, trade with other nations, and defend against invasions while navigating seasonal challenges that impact resources and unit effectiveness. 
With various scenarios, random skirmishes, and a map editor where you can make your own scenarios and share with others, Iterum offers a rich simulation of Roman-era expansion and governance. 

Forge your own story in ITERUM.

Play Iterum ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2069820/Iterum/
